title: Iran war live: Saudi coalition says repels Houthi missile, drone attacks
text:
Iran war live: Saudi coalition says repels Houthi missile, drone attacks

Riyadh’s financial centre was rocked by Houthi missile fire as the conflict leaves ‘lasting mark’ on global energy.

Jerusalem Daily: Israel launches ground offensive in Gaza

Saudi-led coalition forces say they have intercepted multiple Houthi missiles and drones, marking the second night the Gulf country has faced attacks after a skyscraper in Riyadh’s business district was damaged yesterday.

The Houthi health ministry says attacks on Yemen’s capital, Sanaa, have killed 10 people over the past two days as the internationally recognised Yemeni government and the Saudi-led coalition trade fire with the Iran-backed rebel group.
